verdict.rationale: Factory offers Droid Computers and BYOM options, and a web/desktop App with session management, monitoring, and API/SDK access, suggesting some managed cloud execution without local setup. However, evidence emphasizes 'Bring Your Own Machine' (registering your own VPS/workstation) rather than a fully Factory-hosted compute backend, so it's unclear if a pure managed cloud runtime (no user-operated infra at all) is offered. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a fully Factory-hosted/managed cloud compute backend (not just BYOM), independent verification of managed infrastructure, pricing/SLA details for cloud-hosted execution.
